Directions (Q.93–97): Read the following passage summary carefully and answer the questions that follow:
A person's character and taste are reflected both in the friends they keep and in the books they read, so one should always seek the finest company in people as well as in books. A good book ranks among humanity's best companions: steadfast, patient, and cheerful, it never abandons us during adversity or distress. It always receives us with the same kindness, entertaining and engaging us in youth while comforting and consoling us in old age.
